title: Crypto Perpetual Funding Rates & Open Interest
author: powakadata
key_finding: 8 largest Binance USDT perps, 8h funding + mark price + OI back to contract launch (BTC Sep 2019); 76 KB; the compact funding-carry sanity dataset

title: Binance Full History
author: jorijnsmit
key_finding: 1m candlesticks ~2000 pairs incl. multi-quote (BTC-USDT, ADA-EUR), parquet per pair; can re-run screening funnel step 2 offline; 28 GB total

title: High Frequency Crypto Limit Order Book Data
author: martinsn (Martin Søgaard Nielsen)
key_finding: Coinbase WS-derived 15-level LOB snapshots at 1s/1m/5m for BTC/ETH/ADA, ~12 days 2021; includes midpoint+spread columns; only small per-second book data; calibrate width not level

title: CryptoLOB-2025
author: qkxuuuu
key_finding: Deep LOB snapshots for BTC/ETH across 2025, daily files JSON/CSV; 2.2 GB, usability 0.375, 0 attached kernels — schema thin [INFERENCE]

title: Hyperliquid Perps: Funding, Positioning & Signals
author: sebastienlorentz
key_finding: Hourly Hyperliquid funding, basis, order-book depth, OI, cross-venue funding/basis vs Binance and Bybit; only 6 weeks of data at card time — schema analogue to OKX↔Lighter, not statistics

title: Binance Funding Rate History
author: haozhu18
key_finding: Full Binance funding history um+cm (e.g. AAVEUSD_PERP 8h rows, rate 1e-4 decimal); reference for parsing funding across margining conventions

title: Binance Funding Rate Example Notebook
author: haozhu18
key_finding: Starter notebook only loads parquet and plots BTCUSDT funding history — parsing reference, no analysis

title: StatArb Pairs: BayesOpt Kappa-Halflife
author: phamtheanh97 (AnhPhamAlgoDeveloper)
key_finding: OU regression half-life: polyfit of Δspread on spread_lag, half_life=-ln(2)/β, κ=-β; BayesOpt over lookback/entry_threshold/stoploss/half_life; textbook-correct, transplants to calibration.py as ~10 lines

title: Pairs Trading Strategy - Quant
author: addarm (Adam Darmanin)
key_finding: Most-voted pairs kernel (25 votes): rolling z-score on price ratio, ±1σ thresholds; author admits ~100% 2-yr paper return with 50% drawdown and severe commission/execution costs — upper bound, not evidence

title: g-research cointegration analysis
author: wptouxx (zhen)
key_finding: Pairwise CADF (OLS residual + adfuller) over all G-Research assets post-2020, full-sample; reports 'strong cointegration between eth classic and all other assets' — spurious, no multiplicity correction; anti-pattern for screening.py

title: Pairs Trading (Mean Reversion)
author: artemburenok (Artem Burenok)
key_finding: Correlation>0.9 pre-filter, Engle-Granger + ADF, 68/95% bands = p50/p95 percentents as σ multiples; z-score computed over FULL sample mean/std (lookahead); fixed 5/20 lookbacks with no half-life

title: Statistical Arbitrage: A Pairs Trading Strategy
author: sathyanarayanrao89
key_finding: Stock pairs with day alignment and z-score spread signals; equities data, nothing crypto-specific to reuse beyond alignment step

title: Limit Order Book 10 days · 3 market regimes
author: sergionefedov
key_finding: Synthetic 10-day LOB (2.8M events): Poisson arrivals, GBM+mean-reverting mid, 3 regimes, OBI; legitimate harness for two-leg coordination tests (partial fills, re-pegs) without production risk

title: Binance BTCUSDT Non-Aggregated Trades & Order Book
author: krrdev1
key_finding: Non-aggregated trades, 100ms book diffs, 1000-level snapshots since Mar 2026 ongoing; right data for naked-leg unwind fill simulation; single market, heavy

title: DEX Hyperliquid Orderbook Data - 5m
author: adamatractor (Imbalance Labs)
key_finding: 7-day free sample of Hyperliquid L2 10-level depth + 47 features; full 12+ months is paid — sales-gated, skip

title: Hyperliquid L1 Order Flow Microstructure 10 Perps
author: marvingozo
key_finding: 5 days, 6.8B rows of native order lifecycle + wallet-level fills + L2 snapshots; CC-BY-NC-4.0 non-commercial — unusable for live trading infra

title: Bitcoin Funding Rate (Binance Futures)
author: jesusgraterol
key_finding: BTC-only funding history with open-source builder script (github.com/jesusgraterol/binance-futures-dataset-builder); superseded by haozhu18 multi-symbol version

title: Crypto Perp Liquidations - Who Survives
author: sergionefedov
key_finding: 60k simulated positions with liquidation + PnL targets; liquidation path dependence over hourly paths — wrong object for leg-balance but shows simulated-path methodology

title: G-Research Crypto Forecasting (competitions corpus)
author: G-Research/Kaggle
key_finding: Minute-level crypto forecasting competitions; 109k-view tutorial notebooks exist but all target return forecasting, not spread/execution — dead end for arbTwin

title: funding-carry-audit
author: TrippyFrenemy
key_finding: [Surfaced via Kaggle search, not on Kaggle] Delta-neutral funding-carry audit over 883 perp series / 1.49M funding obs / 4 venues: walk-forward, no-lookahead, cost sweeps; found 4 look-ahead bugs in its own harness, reversed conclusion twice, final result null — strongest external validation of arbTwin's fill-at-i+1 paranoia

title: Benchmark Dataset for Mid-Price Forecasting of Limit Order Book Data with Machine Learning Methods
author: Ntakaris et al.
key_finding: The FI-2010-style LOB benchmark lineage CryptoLOB-2025 follows; normalized 10-level features — feature-schema reference for depth-based fill models
